# Axiom Vision v0.18.16 — Cookie Relay

เพิ่ม COOKIE RELAY ต่อจาก Random Boost ในหน้า Universal Loop
- OFF เป็นค่าเริ่มต้น เปิด ON ได้เมื่อเลือก Short / Normal / Custom
- AUTO ใช้ Relay ไม่ได้ เมื่อเปลี่ยนเป็น AUTO ระบบปิด Relay ให้อัตโนมัติ
- ขณะเปิด Relay เวลาของ Run Profile หมายถึงเวลาประมาณของ Cookie ตัวแรก
  เลือก Custom หากต้องการระบุเวลาให้ตรงกับตัวที่ใช้อยู่

วิธีทำงาน
- ใช้เวลา Profile ช่วยเริ่มเฝ้าภาพก่อนถึงเวลาคาดหมาย โดยเผื่ออย่างน้อย60วินาที
  หรือ30% ของเวลาตัวแรก เช่น Short180เริ่มเฝ้าประมาณ120วินาที
- เว้นพัก0.15วินาทีระหว่างการตรวจในช่วงเฝ้า มีเวลาจับภาพ/ประมวลผลเพิ่ม
  ใช้ตัวตรวจภาพLocal
  ไม่รอ Codex หรือ OCR ทั้งภาพในเส้นทางกดปุ่มช่วงสั้น
- ต้องเห็นข้อความ Relay กรอบปุ่ม และองค์ประกอบหน้าRunningในภาพสดจริง
  ตรวจซ้ำก่อนส่งinput ไม่กดจากเวลา/ตำแหน่งเก่าเพียงอย่างเดียว
- ใช้คำสั่งกดได้หนึ่งครั้งต่อloop บันทึกintent/commitแยกจากstage Running
  เมื่อมีคำสั่งที่ผลไม่แน่ชัดจะไม่กดซ้ำหลังrestart
- หากปุ่มไม่ปรากฏหรือพลาดช่วงเวลา ยังสังเกตResultตามเส้นทางเดิม
- โหมดOFFใช้MissionและPlanhashเดิมrevision9; ONใช้revision10
  เก็บตัวเลือกไว้ในfrozenPlanและแสดงในสถานะ/แผนผ่านTelegram

Stop/Pause/Human Verification, foreground/geometry, freshness, durable input,
watchdog และ never-replay guards ยังทำงาน ไม่มีสิทธิ์คลิกทั่วไปขณะRunning
Relay ไม่เพิ่มหรือรีเซ็ต budget ของStage; ขีดจำกัดRunningเดิมยังอยู่
Customที่ใกล้ขีดจำกัด1800วินาทีอาจไม่มีเวลาพอสำหรับCookieตัวที่สอง
ระบบอ่านสมบัติ/วัตถุดิบยังปิดตามเดิม Heart Sender ไม่เปลี่ยน

การตรวจรุ่นนี้ใช้ภาพที่ผู้ใช้ให้และการจำลองinput/เวลา/การรีสตาร์ตบนLinux
ยังไม่ได้ยืนยันการกดทันหน้าต่าง2วินาทีด้วยWindows/LDPlayerจริง

อัปเดตที่Settings → CHECK UPDATE แล้วรอช่วงที่updaterติดตั้งได้
state/checkpoint/stats/sessionเดิมคงอยู่ activecheckpointเลื่อนการติดตั้ง
ไม่ต้องReset Batchเพื่อรับอัปเดต

@staticmethod
    def _cookie_relay_contract(session: BridgeSession) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        config = getattr(session, "universal_config", None) or {}
        relay = config.get("cookie_relay") if isinstance(config, dict) else None
        if not (getattr(session, "mission_source", None) == "universal-code"
                and isinstance(relay, dict) and relay.get("enabled") is True):
            return None
        _index, step = session.stage_by_id("passive-running")
        contract = step.get("cookie_relay")
        if not (isinstance(contract, dict) and contract.get("enabled") is True
                and contract.get("target_id") == "cookie-relay"
                and contract.get("max_attempts") == 1
                and contract.get("replay") == "never"
                and isinstance(contract.get("pointer_guard"), dict)
                and type(contract.get("expected_first_runner_seconds")) is int
                and contract["expected_first_runner_seconds"] >= 30
                and (config.get("run_profile") or {}).get("mode") in {"short", "normal", "custom"}):
            raise BridgeError("Cookie Relay requires its exact compiled non-AUTO contract")
        return contract

    @staticmethod
    def _cookie_relay_watch_delay(session: BridgeSession, contract: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
        expected = float(contract["expected_first_runner_seconds"])
        lead = max(60.0, expected * 0.30)
        baseline = (session.running_entry_attestation or {}).get("running_entry_active_elapsed_seconds")
        current = session.active_elapsed_seconds()
        if not (isinstance(baseline, (int, float)) and not isinstance(baseline, bool)
                and math.isfinite(baseline) and 0 <= baseline <= current):
            return 0.0
        return max(0.0, expected - lead - (current - baseline))

    @staticmethod
    def _detect_cookie_relay(image: bytes) -> Any:
        from visionstudio_cookie_relay import detect_cookie_relay
        return detect_cookie_relay(image)

    def _cookie_relay_human_guard(self, session: BridgeSession, window: WindowInfo, image: bytes) -> bool:
        # Fast negative samples remain private. Only a real Human challenge is
        # promoted so its durable pause image is the exact matching witness.
        if (self.session is not session or session.stopped
                or not session.running_monitor_active or session.running_monitor_stop.is_set()
                or session.running_monitor_thread is not threading.current_thread()
                or session.current_stage_id != "passive-running"
                or session.current_stage_phase != "entered"):
            return False
        detector = detect_human_verification_frame(image)
        if detector.get("error") or detector.get("distance") is None:
            raise BridgeError("Cookie Relay Human Guard is unavailable; no Relay input is permitted")
        if not detector.get("matched"):
            return False
        result = self._latch_human_verification(session, window, "passive-running",
            "Known card verification detected during Cookie Relay watch", detector=detector,
            _cookie_relay_batch_id=session._cookie_relay_controller_batch_id,
            _cookie_relay_frame=image)
        return result.get("cookie_relay_latch_cancelled") is not True

    def _cookie_relay_authority(self, session: BridgeSession, *, pending_id: str | None = None) -> bool:
        session.ensure_live()
        session.ensure_not_terminal()
        session.check_stage_watchdog()
        if not (self.session is session and session.running_monitor_active
                and session.running_monitor_thread is threading.current_thread()
                and not session.running_monitor_stop.is_set()
                and session.current_stage_id == "passive-running"
                and session.current_stage_phase == "entered"
                and not session.paused_for_human and not session.resume_required
                and not session.resume_confirmation_pending
                and not session.checkpoint_recovery_pending
                and not session.stage_action_replay_blocked
                and session.pending_action_intent is None
                and session.local_recovery_pending_intent is None
                and session.actions < session.safety["max_actions"]
                and session.fixed_geometry_bounds is not None):
            return False
        session.ensure_gui_input_lockout_cleared()
        state = self._controller_gate(session)
        if not (state.get("_attached") is True and state.get("desired_state") == "running"):
            return False
        batch = state.get("batch_plan") or {}
        frozen = batch.get("universal_config")
        identity = batch.get("universal_plan") or {}
        if not (batch.get("status") == "active"
                and isinstance(session._cookie_relay_controller_batch_id, str)
                and session._cookie_relay_controller_batch_id
                and batch.get("batch_id") == session._cookie_relay_controller_batch_id
                and identity.get("mission_id") == universal_mission_module.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_ID
                and frozen == session.universal_config
                and identity.get("sha256") == session.mission_contract_sha256
                and str(identity.get("revision")) == "10"
                and state.get("universal_config") == frozen
                and state.get("universal_plan") == identity
                and (state.get("fixed_geometry") or {}).get("bounds")
                    == list(session.fixed_geometry_bounds)):
            raise BridgeError("Cookie Relay frozen Controller Plan or geometry changed")
        target = batch.get("requested_loops")
        completed = batch.get("completed_loops", 0)
        if target is not None and (type(target) is not int or type(completed) is not int
                                   or target < 1 or completed < 0 or completed >= target):
            return False
        compiled = universal_mission_module.compile_universal_mission(frozen)
        if (compiled.plan_hash != session.mission_contract_sha256
                or compiled.mission != session.mission
                or not exact_universal_stage_prefix_matches(session, "passive-running")
                or not universal_loop_start_anchor_matches_session(session)):
            raise BridgeError("Cookie Relay Mission or ordered Running proof changed")
        ledger = session.cookie_relay_state
        return bool(isinstance(ledger, dict)
            and ledger.get("mission_sha256") == session.mission_contract_sha256
            and ledger.get("origin_session_id") == (session.recovery_origin_session_id or session.id)
            and ((pending_id is None and ledger.get("status") == "ready" and ledger.get("attempts") == 0)
                 or (pending_id is not None and ledger.get("status") == "pending"
                     and ledger.get("attempts") == 1 and ledger.get("intent_id") == pending_id)))

    @staticmethod
    def _cookie_relay_target_allowed(contract: dict[str, Any], proof: Any) -> bool:
        guard = contract["pointer_guard"]
        canonical = guard["canonical_grid_region"]
        declared = vision_grid_region_to_capture(proof.capture_size,
            int(canonical["x"]), int(canonical["y"]),
            int(canonical["width"]), int(canonical["height"]))
        allowed = guard["allowed_grid_region"]
        ax, ay, aw, ah = vision_grid_region_to_capture(proof.capture_size,
            int(allowed["x"]), int(allowed["y"]), int(allowed["width"]), int(allowed["height"]))
        px, py, pw, ph = proof.target_bounds
        return bool(pw > 0 and ph > 0 and ax <= px and ay <= py
            and px + pw <= ax + aw and py + ph <= ay + ah
            and pw * 1000 <= int(guard["max_target_width"]) * proof.capture_size[0]
            and ph * 1000 <= int(guard["max_target_height"]) * proof.capture_size[1]
            and declared[0] <= proof.center[0] < declared[0] + declared[2]
            and declared[1] <= proof.center[1] < declared[1] + declared[3])

    @staticmethod
    def _cookie_relay_same_target(first: Any, second: Any) -> bool:
        if tuple(first.capture_size) != tuple(second.capture_size):
            return False
        fx, fy, fw, fh = second.target_bounds
        px, py, pw, ph = first.target_bounds
        intersection = max(0, min(fx + fw, px + pw) - max(fx, px)) * max(0, min(fy + fh, py + ph) - max(fy, py))
        union = fw * fh + pw * ph - intersection
        return bool(union > 0 and intersection / union >= .90
            and px + pw * .2 <= second.center[0] < px + pw * .8
            and py + ph * .2 <= second.center[1] < py + ph * .8)

    def _try_cookie_relay(self, session: BridgeSession, window: WindowInfo,
                          image: bytes, captured_at: float) -> bool:
        """One private, two-witness Relay input; no main Stage action rights."""
        if time.monotonic() - captured_at > LOCAL_ATOMIC_WITNESS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
            return False
        proof = self._detect_cookie_relay(image)
        if proof is None:
            return False
        contract = self._cookie_relay_contract(session)
        if contract is None:
            return False
        visual = contract.get("visual_detector")
        if not (isinstance(visual, dict) and isinstance(visual.get("version"), str)
                and proof.detector_version == visual["version"]):
            raise BridgeError("Cookie Relay detector version differs from the frozen Plan")
        with session.runtime_transition_lock:
            if self._cookie_relay_human_guard(session, window, image):
                return False
            if not self._cookie_relay_authority(session):
                return False
            if time.monotonic() - captured_at > LOCAL_ATOMIC_WITNESS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
                return False
            bounds = (window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height)
            if bounds != session.fixed_geometry_bounds or proof.frame_sha256 != sha256_bytes(image):
                return False
            if not self._cookie_relay_target_allowed(contract, proof):
                return False
            # A pop-in frame is not an input attempt. Confirm a second stable
            # semantic match before reserving the never-replay allowance.
            preflight_window = self._verified_action_window(session)
            preflight_at = time.monotonic()
            preflight_image, preflight_health = self._capture_reliable_png(preflight_window)
            if (time.monotonic() - preflight_at > LOCAL_ATOMIC_WITNESS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
                    or preflight_health.get("confirmed_black")
                    or self._cookie_relay_human_guard(session, preflight_window, preflight_image)):
                return False
            preflight = self._detect_cookie_relay(preflight_image)
            if (preflight is None or preflight.detector_version != visual["version"]
                    or preflight.frame_sha256 != sha256_bytes(preflight_image)
                    or not self._cookie_relay_target_allowed(contract, preflight)
                    or not self._cookie_relay_same_target(proof, preflight)
                    or preflight_window.hwnd != window.hwnd
                    or (preflight_window.left, preflight_window.top, preflight_window.width, preflight_window.height) != bounds
                    or time.monotonic() - preflight_at > LOCAL_ATOMIC_WITNESS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
                    or not self._cookie_relay_authority(session)):
                return False
            image, proof = preflight_image, preflight
            intent_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
            session.cookie_relay_state = {
                **session.cookie_relay_state, "status": "pending", "attempts": 1,
                "intent_id": intent_id, "target_id": "cookie-relay", "replay": "never",
                "action_number": session.actions + 1, "detector_version": proof.detector_version,
                "prepared_at": mission_module.utc_now(), "before_frame_sha256": proof.frame_sha256,
                "fixed_geometry_bounds": list(bounds),
            }
            session.write_checkpoint("cookie_relay_intent_prepared")
            native_dispatch_started = False
            def rejected(reason: str) -> bool:
                mission_module.append_event(session.journal_path, {
                    "event": "cookie_relay_rejected", "timestamp": mission_module.utc_now(),
                    "session_id": session.id, "stage_id": "passive-running", "intent_id": intent_id,
                    "reason": reason, "native_dispatch_started": native_dispatch_started,
                    "allowance_consumed": True, "replay_allowed": False,
                })
                return False
            try:
                # Every failure after this durable boundary consumes the one Relay
                # allowance. A process restart can only observe its visible result.
                dispatch_window = self._verified_action_window(session)
                dispatch_at = time.monotonic()
                dispatch_image, health = self._capture_reliable_png(dispatch_window)
                if time.monotonic() - dispatch_at > LOCAL_ATOMIC_WITNESS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
                    return rejected("dispatch_capture_expired")
                if health.get("confirmed_black") or self._cookie_relay_human_guard(session, dispatch_window, dispatch_image):
                    return rejected("human_or_black_frame")
                final = self._detect_cookie_relay(dispatch_image)
                if (final is None or final.detector_version != visual["version"]
                        or final.frame_sha256 != sha256_bytes(dispatch_image)
                        or tuple(final.capture_size) != tuple(proof.capture_size)
                        or not self._cookie_relay_target_allowed(contract, final)):
                    return rejected("dispatch_scene_not_proved")
                if not self._cookie_relay_same_target(proof, final):
                    return rejected("dispatch_target_moved")
                freshness = compare_frame_freshness(image, dispatch_image, tuple(final.target_bounds))
                # The Running background is animated by definition. This narrow
                # guard checks the proven Relay control region and a second exact
                # semantic match; all full-frame Human checks remain mandatory.
                if (freshness.get("dimensions_match") is not True
                        or freshness.get("region_mean_delta") is None
                        or (freshness["region_mean_delta"] > FRESHNESS_REGION_MEAN_DELTA_LIMIT
                            and freshness["region_changed_ratio"] > FRESHNESS_REGION_CHANGED_RATIO_LIMIT)):
                    return rejected("dispatch_control_changed")
                if not self._cookie_relay_authority(session, pending_id=intent_id):
                    return rejected("controller_or_stage_boundary")
                atomic_window = self._verified_action_window(session)
                if (atomic_window.hwnd != window.hwnd
                        or (atomic_window.left, atomic_window.top, atomic_window.width, atomic_window.height) != bounds
                        or time.monotonic() - dispatch_at > LOCAL_ATOMIC_WITNESS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS):
                    return rejected("dispatch_geometry_or_age")
                selected = tuple(final.center)
                x, y, width, height = final.target_bounds
                if not (x + width * .2 <= selected[0] < x + width * .8
                        and y + height * .2 <= selected[1] < y + height * .8):
                    return rejected("dispatch_point_not_interior")
                screen = capture_to_screen(atomic_window, final.capture_size, *selected)
                native_dispatch_started = True
                telemetry = self._desktop().click(*screen, "left", 1)
                session.actions += 1
                session.cookie_relay_state = {
                    **session.cookie_relay_state, "status": "committed",
                    "committed_at": mission_module.utc_now(), "action_number": session.actions,
                    "dispatch_frame_sha256": final.frame_sha256, "selected_point": list(selected),
                }
                session.needs_observation = True
                session.write_checkpoint("cookie_relay_action_committed")
                mission_module.append_event(session.journal_path, {
                    "event": "cookie_relay_input_committed", "timestamp": mission_module.utc_now(),
                    "session_id": session.id, "stage_id": "passive-running", "target_id": "cookie-relay",
                    "action_number": session.actions, "intent_id": intent_id,
                    "before_frame_sha256": proof.frame_sha256, "dispatch_frame_sha256": final.frame_sha256,
                    "detector_version": final.detector_version, "input": telemetry,
                    "watchdog_transaction_serialized": True, "main_stage_action_committed": False,
                    "game_effect_confirmed": False,
                })
                # Commit is already durable. A fresh post-input witness is retained
                # separately from the consumer's ordinary published sample. Its
                # absence/failure can never reopen the single Relay allowance.
                try:
                    post_window = self._verified_window(session)
                    post_image, post_health = self._capture_reliable_png(post_window)
                    if (self.session is not session or session.stopped
                            or not session.running_monitor_active or session.running_monitor_stop.is_set()):
                        raise BridgeError("Cookie Relay monitor generation ended after input; post witness not published")
                    post_hash = sha256_bytes(post_image)
                    session.cookie_relay_state = {**session.cookie_relay_state,
                        "post_frame_sha256": post_hash, "post_observed_at": mission_module.utc_now(),
                        "game_effect_confirmed": False}
                    session.write_checkpoint("cookie_relay_post_input_observed")
                    mission_module.append_event(session.journal_path, {
                        "event": "cookie_relay_post_input_observed", "timestamp": mission_module.utc_now(),
                        "session_id": session.id, "intent_id": intent_id, "frame_sha256": post_hash,
                        "capture_health": post_health, "game_effect_confirmed": False,
                    })
                    self._cookie_relay_human_guard(session, post_window, post_image)
                except (BridgeError, OSError) as exc:
                    mission_module.append_event(session.journal_path, {
                        "event": "cookie_relay_post_input_failed", "timestamp": mission_module.utc_now(),
                        "session_id": session.id, "intent_id": intent_id,
                        "input_committed": True, "replay_allowed": False,
                        "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                    })
                return True
            except Exception as exc:

"""Fast, calibrated Cookie Relay visual evidence; this module sends no input.

The detector locates a closed yellow/green card, then verifies the complete
Relay prompt and both Running controls at the same inferred scale/translation.
Cookie artwork, scores and HP timing do not establish a match. A returned proof
must still pass Bridge Controller, Human, foreground, geometry and input guards.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import lru_cache
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageFilter

DETECTOR_VERSION = "cookie-relay-visual-1"
_CANVAS = (800, 450)
_YELLOW_REFERENCE = (359, 166, 457, 264)
_TARGET_REFERENCE = (357, 164, 459, 267)
_SEARCH = (325, 135, 490, 295)
_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 16_000_000
_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = 16_000_000
_WORD_BOXES = ((1, 4, 35, 23), (41, 4, 61, 23), (67, 4, 143, 23),
               (148, 4, 210, 23), (216, 4, 265, 24), (270, 4, 330, 23))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CookieRelayProof:
    frame_sha256: str
    capture_size: tuple[int, int]
    target_bounds: tuple[int, int, int, int]
    center: tuple[int, int]
    confidence: float
    detector_version: str = DETECTOR_VERSION


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _signatures() -> dict[str, tuple[tuple[int, int, int, int], Image.Image]]:
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data" / "cookie-relay-signatures.json"
    value = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    if value.get("schema_version") != 1 or value.get("detector_version") != DETECTOR_VERSION:
        raise ValueError("Cookie Relay signature version mismatch")
    result = {}
    for name in ("prompt", "jump", "slide"):
        item = value["signatures"][name]
        mask = Image.frombytes("1", tuple(item["size"]), base64.b85decode(item["mask_b85"])).convert("L")
        result[name] = (tuple(item["box"]), mask)
    return result


def _white(image: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    red, green, blue = image.split()
    minimum = ImageChops.darker(ImageChops.darker(red, green), blue)
    maximum = ImageChops.lighter(ImageChops.lighter(red, green), blue)
    return ImageChops.multiply(
        minimum.point(lambda value: 255 if value >= 205 else 0),
        ImageChops.subtract(maximum, minimum).point(lambda value: 255 if value <= 50 else 0),
    )


def _count(mask: Image.Image) -> int:
    return mask.histogram()[255]


def _shape_score(reference: Image.Image, actual: Image.Image) -> float:
    """Symmetric one-pixel shape agreement; solid white panels do not match."""
    ref_count, actual_count = _count(reference), _count(actual)
    if ref_count < 4 or actual_count < 4:
        return 0.0
    recall = _count(ImageChops.multiply(reference, actual.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3)))) / ref_count
    precision = _count(ImageChops.multiply(actual, reference.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3)))) / actual_count
    return min(recall, precision)


def _yellow(rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> bool:
    red, green, blue = rgb
    return bool(red > 175 and green > 165 and blue < 125 and red > blue * 1.45 and green > blue * 1.4)


def _green(rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> bool:
    red, green, blue = rgb
    return bool(green > 100 and green > red * .94 and green > blue * 1.3 and red < 215)


def _card_candidates(image: Image.Image) -> list[tuple[int, int, int, int]]:
    region = image.crop(_SEARCH)
    width, height = region.size
    pixels = region.load()
    seen = bytearray(width * height)
    candidates = []
    for y in range(height):
        for x in range(width):
            index = y * width + x
            if seen[index]:
                continue
            seen[index] = 1
            if not _yellow(pixels[x, y]):
                continue
            stack = [(x, y)]
            left = right = x
            top = bottom = y
            count = 0
            while stack:
                px, py = stack.pop()
                count += 1
                left, right = min(left, px), max(right, px)
                top, bottom = min(top, py), max(bottom, py)
                for nx, ny in ((px-1, py), (px+1, py), (px, py-1), (px, py+1)):
                    if not (0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height):
                        continue
                    next_index = ny * width + nx
                    if seen[next_index]:
                        continue
                    seen[next_index] = 1
                    if _yellow(pixels[nx, ny]):
                        stack.append((nx, ny))
            box_width, box_height = right - left + 1, bottom - top + 1
            if (84 <= box_width <= 113 and 84 <= box_height <= 113
                    and .91 <= box_width / box_height <= 1.09
                    and .035 <= count / (box_width * box_height) <= .19):
                candidates.append((left + _SEARCH[0], top + _SEARCH[1],
                                   right + _SEARCH[0] + 1, bottom + _SEARCH[1] + 1))
    return candidates[:5]


def _transformed_box(box: tuple[int, int, int, int], card: tuple[int, int, int, int]) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    sx = (card[2] - card[0]) / (_YELLOW_REFERENCE[2] - _YELLOW_REFERENCE[0])
    sy = (card[3] - card[1]) / (_YELLOW_REFERENCE[3] - _YELLOW_REFERENCE[1])
    return (round(card[0] + (box[0] - _YELLOW_REFERENCE[0]) * sx),
            round(card[1] + (box[1] - _YELLOW_REFERENCE[1]) * sy),
            round(card[0] + (box[2] - _YELLOW_REFERENCE[0]) * sx),
            round(card[1] + (box[3] - _YELLOW_REFERENCE[1]) * sy))


def _fraction(image: Image.Image, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], predicate: Any) -> float:
    part = image.crop(box)
    pixels = part.load()
    if part.width < 1 or part.height < 1:
        return 0.0
    return sum(predicate(pixels[x, y]) for y in range(part.height) for x in range(part.width)) / (part.width * part.height)


def _card_frame_matches(image: Image.Image, card: tuple[int, int, int, int]) -> bool:
    yellow_edges = ((365,166,451,169), (365,261,451,264),
                    (358,174,361,255), (455,174,458,255))
    green_edges = ((366,172,451,175), (366,256,451,259),
                   (364,177,367,254), (449,177,452,254))
    return bool(
        all(_fraction(image, _transformed_box(edge, card), _yellow) >= .43 for edge in yellow_edges)
        and all(_fraction(image, _transformed_box(edge, card), _green) >= .58 for edge in green_edges)
    )


def _signature_score(image: Image.Image, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], reference: Image.Image,
                     *, prompt: bool = False) -> float:
    # A one-pixel component-boundary shift must not become a missed two-second
    # control. Every word is checked at the same translation; arbitrary phrases
    # and an isolated bright rectangle cannot satisfy the signature.
    best = 0.0
    for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
        for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
            shifted = (box[0]+dx, box[1]+dy, box[2]+dx, box[3]+dy)
            actual = _white(image.crop(shifted).resize(reference.size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
            if prompt:
                scores = [_shape_score(reference.crop(word), actual.crop(word)) for word in _WORD_BOXES]
                score = min(scores)
            else:
                score = _shape_score(reference, actual)
            best = max(best, score)
    return best


def detect_cookie_relay(png: bytes) -> CookieRelayProof | None:
    """Return one frame-bound match or None, with bounded work and no OCR.

    Known calibration covers a 16:9 game surface plus modest emulator chrome
    (up to about 35 px vertical at 900 px game height). UI language must match
    the supplied English Relay prompt. Missing or ambiguous evidence fails closed.
    """
    if not isinstance(png, bytes) or not png or len(png) > _MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
        return None
    try:
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(png)) as source:
            width, height = source.size
            if (width < 640 or height < 360 or width * height > _MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
                    or not 1.65 <= width / height <= 1.9):
                return None
            source.load()
            image = source.convert("RGB").resize(_CANVAS, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        signatures = _signatures()
        accepted = []
        for card in _card_candidates(image):
            if not _card_frame_matches(image, card):
                continue
            prompt_box, prompt_mask = signatures["prompt"]
            prompt_score = _signature_score(image, _transformed_box(prompt_box, card), prompt_mask, prompt=True)
            if prompt_score < .88:
                continue
            scores = [prompt_score]
            for name in ("jump", "slide"):
                box, mask = signatures[name]
                scores.append(_signature_score(image, _transformed_box(box, card), mask))
            if min(scores[1:]) < .85:
                continue
            left, top, right, bottom = _transformed_box(_TARGET_REFERENCE, card)
            bounds = (round(left * width / 800), round(top * height / 450),
                      round((right - left) * width / 800), round((bottom - top) * height / 450))
            center = (bounds[0] + bounds[2] // 2, bounds[1] + bounds[3] // 2)
            accepted.append(CookieRelayProof(hashlib.sha256(png).hexdigest(), (width, height), bounds,
                                             center, round(min(scores), 4)))
        return accepted[0] if len(accepted) == 1 else None
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, Image.DecompressionBombError):
        return None

def config(profile='short', enabled=True):
    value = {
        'schema_version': 1,
        'random_boost': {'mode': 'targeted', 'target': 'Double Coins'},
        'run_profile': {'mode': profile, 'expected_seconds': 140 if profile == 'custom' else None},
        'requested_loops': None, 'telegram_summary': True,
    }
    if enabled is not None:
        value['cookie_relay'] = {'enabled': enabled}
    return value


class Variable:
    def __init__(self, value): self.value = value
    def get(self): return self.value
    def set(self, value): self.value = value


class CookieRelayConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_disabled_mode_keeps_revision_nine_exact_config_and_hash(self):
        legacy = config('custom', None)
        off = config('custom', False)
        self.assertEqual(universal.normalize_universal_config(off), universal.normalize_universal_config(legacy))
        compiled = universal.compile_universal_mission(off)
        self.assertEqual(compiled.plan_hash, '19f45f9c2bae8a2d549443fa80dac3062597d9a3f3709a85c9353bc3f08d9d0a')
        self.assertEqual(compiled.contract_hash, '197c8e00cb02a6cd2bfc1dc1ca751d2e5dfd50bd998add7874bbd6e1f944073a')
        self.assertEqual(compiled.mission['universal_plan']['plan_revision'], 9)
        self.assertNotIn('cookie_relay', compiled.normalized_config)
        self.assertTrue(all('cookie_relay' not in step for step in compiled.mission['steps']))

    def test_enabled_mode_changes_identity_and_only_private_running_contract(self):
        for profile in ('short', 'normal', 'custom'):
            with self.subTest(profile=profile):
                on = universal.compile_universal_mission(config(profile))
                off = universal.compile_universal_mission(config(profile, False))
                visionstudio.validate_mission(on.mission)
                self.assertNotEqual(on.plan_hash, off.plan_hash)
                self.assertEqual(on.mission['universal_plan']['plan_revision'], 10)
                passive = next(step for step in on.mission['steps'] if step['id'] == 'passive-running')
                self.assertEqual(passive['action']['allowed'], ['wait', 'verify'])
                relay = passive['cookie_relay']
                self.assertEqual(relay['target_id'], 'cookie-relay')
                self.assertEqual(relay['max_attempts'], 1)
                self.assertEqual(relay['replay'], 'never')
                self.assertEqual(relay['watch_interval_seconds'], .15)
                self.assertGreaterEqual(relay['watch_lead_seconds'], 60)
                self.assertNotIn('pointer_guard', passive['action'])
                self.assertEqual([step['id'] for step in on.mission['steps'] if 'cookie_relay' in step], ['passive-running'])

    def test_relay_plan_binds_actual_detector_version_and_signature_bytes(self):
        from visionstudio_cookie_relay import DETECTOR_VERSION
        compiled = universal.compile_universal_mission(config())
        relay = next(step for step in compiled.mission['steps'] if step['id'] == 'passive-running')['cookie_relay']
        self.assertEqual(relay['visual_detector'], {
            'version': DETECTOR_VERSION,

        })

        on = universal.compile_universal_mission(config())

        identity = dict(universal._cookie_relay_detector_identity())
        identity['signatures_sha256'] = '0' * 64

            self.assertNotEqual(changed_on.plan_hash, on.plan_hash)
            self.assertNotEqual(changed_on.contract_hash, on.contract_hash)
            self.assertEqual(changed_off.plan_hash, off.plan_hash)

            self.assertEqual(universal.compile_universal_mission(config(enabled=False)).plan_hash, off.plan_hash)

    def test_relay_slow_loop_reporting_allows_second_runner_without_changing_budgets(self):
        for profile in ('short', 'normal', 'custom'):

                off_performance.pop('slow_loop_warning_seconds')

        self.assertEqual(universal.compile_universal_mission(longest).mission['performance']['slow_loop_warning_seconds'], 3600)

    def test_auto_and_invalid_enabled_values_are_rejected_by_both_normalizers(self):

def relay_plan(state, checkpoint):
    old = checkpoint["mission_contract_sha256"]
    config = copy.deepcopy(checkpoint["universal_config"])
    config["run_profile"] = {"mode": "short", "expected_seconds": 180}
    config["cookie_relay"] = {"enabled": True}
    compiled = compile_universal_mission(config)
    def rebind(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: rebind(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list): return [rebind(v) for v in value]
        return compiled.plan_hash if value == old else value
    state, checkpoint = rebind(state), rebind(checkpoint)
    identity = {"mission_id": "universal-loop", "revision": "10", "sha256": compiled.plan_hash}
    state["universal_config"] = copy.deepcopy(config)
    state["universal_plan"] = copy.deepcopy(identity)
    state["batch_plan"]["universal_config"] = copy.deepcopy(config)
    state["batch_plan"]["universal_plan"] = copy.deepcopy(identity)
    checkpoint["universal_config"] = config
    return state, checkpoint

from __future__ import annotations

import base64

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
from visionstudio_cookie_relay import DETECTOR_VERSION, detect_cookie_relay


def png(image: Image.Image) -> bytes:
    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, format="PNG")
    return output.getvalue()


def relay_frame() -> Image.Image:
    """Synthetic UI using only redacted field glyphs, with arbitrary cookie art.

    No original score, player identity or full screenshot is a test dependency.
    The exact supplied native frame is checked separately before publication.
    """
    source = json.loads((ROOT / "scripts/data/cookie-relay-signatures.json").read_bytes())
    image = Image.new("RGB", (800, 450), (75, 95, 65))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    draw.rectangle((358, 165, 457, 265), fill=(124, 185, 58))
    # Only the field card's narrow frame survives this redacted fixture. Its
    # center is transparent: all Cookie artwork and surrounding frame data are
    # excluded. Keeping the actual antialiasing exercises native-size capture.
    frame = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/fixtures/cookie-relay-frame-border.json").read_bytes())
    field_border = Image.frombytes("RGBA", tuple(frame["size"]),
                                   zlib.decompress(base64.b85decode(frame["rgba_zlib_b85"])))
    border = field_border.resize((102, 103), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    image.paste(border, (357, 164), border)
    # Arbitrary character artwork occupies only the card interior.
    draw.ellipse((380, 188, 430, 243), fill=(30, 80, 220))
    for name in ("prompt", "jump", "slide"):
        item = source["signatures"][name]
        mask = Image.frombytes("1", tuple(item["size"]), base64.b85decode(item["mask_b85"])).convert("L")
        box = tuple(item["box"])
        image.paste((15, 16, 13), box, mask.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3)))
        image.paste((255, 255, 255), box, mask)
    return image


class CookieRelayVisionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_frame_bound_proof_names_observed_card_and_never_returns_input(self):
        image = relay_frame()
        data = png(image)
        proof = detect_cookie_relay(data)
        self.assertIsNotNone(proof)
        self.assertEqual(proof.frame_sha256, hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(proof.capture_size, (800, 450))
        self.assertEqual(proof.detector_version, DETECTOR_VERSION)
        left, top, width, height = proof.target_bounds
        self.assertTrue(left < proof.center[0] < left + width)
        self.assertTrue(top < proof.center[1] < top + height)
        self.assertLessEqual(abs(proof.center[0] - 408), 2)
        self.assertLessEqual(abs(proof.center[1] - 215), 2)

    def test_native_scales_and_emulator_chrome_transform_the_detected_target(self):
        base = relay_frame()
        for size in ((960, 540), (1280, 720), (1600, 900), (1642, 941), (1920, 1080)):
            with self.subTest(size=size):
                proof = detect_cookie_relay(png(base.resize(size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)))
                self.assertIsNotNone(proof)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(proof.center[0] / size[0], .51, delta=.006)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(proof.center[1] / size[1], .48, delta=.006)
        for top in (17, 35):
            with self.subTest(chrome=top):
                game = base.resize((1642, 924), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                image = Image.new("RGB", (1642, 924 + top), (35, 35, 40))
                image.paste(game, (0, top))
                proof = detect_cookie_relay(png(image))
                self.assertIsNotNone(proof)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(proof.center[1], .48 * 924 + top, delta=5)

        proof = detect_cookie_relay(png(image))
        self.assertIsNotNone(proof)
